source_text: Agnus anni et turtur, vel duo turtures si pauper. Maria pauperum munus obtulit. Christus agnus.
pass_a_gloss: Lamb of-year and turtledove, or two turtledoves if poor. Mary of-poor gift offered. Christ lamb.
pass_b_english: A [[year-old lamb and a turtledove, or two turtledoves if poor >> Bible:Leviticus 12:6-8]]. Mary offered the poor’s gift. Christ is the Lamb.
